rules: Each registered non-log built-in family has exactly one complete current value mapping. Ordered logs remain timeline or dedicated current roster projections; clients never replay them for governance.

Selector scope and CellRef define identity. Target is immutable interest ownership, derived by the registered rule from accepted source coordinates, never chosen by the caller or inferred from Event order.
Materialized object values exclude fields owned by distinct cells; the complete remaining head value is returned, never an update patch.
The enclosing Realm target never grants visibility into a Circle; current and frozen visibility must both allow every disclosed result.

families.reason: Historical notification assertions are not current device state; use the account device_lists channel and current device queries.

budgets.counting_rule: RFC 8785 UTF-8 bytes of the complete CurrentResultEntry, including selector, target, revision and complete result/head envelopes. The limit is independent of request coverage and frame occupancy.
